name: Cella Space Limited
about: Cella Space Limited engages in the logistics business in India. The company operates industrial and logistics parks for logistics operations. It also develops houses, villas, commercial establishments, apartments, resorts, etc., as well as infrastructure projects, such as roads and bridges. In addition, the company is involved in leasing activities and trading of kraft paper products. Cella Space Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Cochin, India.
